tagline.en_US: Wolfenstein: Blade of Agony is a story-driven WWII shooter inspired by Wolfenstein and Doom.

description.en_US: Blade of Agony is a story-driven WWII first-person shooter inspired by classic games like Wolfenstein and Doom. It delivers retro-style gameplay with narrative-focused campaign missions. Players engage in combat against enemy forces using period-themed and classic weaponry.

tips: Use Gaming Mode by clicking the small crosshair in the top right of the sidebar for relative mouse and keyboard input.
Exit Gaming Mode by holding down the escape key for 3 seconds.
